observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR body labeled 'Canon EOS 600D' with an EF-S 18-55mm kit lens (cap on) and a strap labeled 'Canon Digital'.
Photo 1 shows the same body from the back with a flip-out LCD screen (closed/folded in), control dials and buttons visible, screen not powered on.
Photo 2 shows the 600D next to what looks like a Canon EOS 700D and a Nikon lens cap in the background, suggesting a shelf of multiple cameras for sale, not a single clean listing of one item.
No close-up of the lens glass, sensor, or LCD screen in use.
No photo of battery, charger, or any shutter-count/menu screen.
Small marks/scuffs visible on top plate edge in photo 0, not close enough to assess severity.

claims.claim: UK used, very neat and sharp
claims.evidence: No test shot or sharp sample image shown; only shelf photos of the body.
No screenshot of camera menu or shutter-count software shown in any photo.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens cap is on in photos 0 and 1; photo 2 lens is too small/distant to inspect glass clarity.
Neither battery nor charger is visible in any of the 3 photos.
No internal or screw-tamper photos provided; cannot be confirmed from exterior shelf shots.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be much higher than claimed, affecting mechanical lifespan.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the camera's shutter count via menu or free shutter-count software on a computer.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high shutter count / near end-of-life shutter

risks.risk: Lens could have fungus, haze, or scratches not visible due to lens cap being on.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens held up to light showing front and rear elements clearly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if lens has fungus/haze (worst case)

risks.risk: LCD screen or autofocus/sensor could be faulty since no powered-on or sample shot is shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the camera powered on with LCD displaying an image, plus a sample photo taken with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not fully working (screen/AF/sensor fault assumed)

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not actually be included or may be third-party/non-OEM.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger together with the camera, showing Canon branding/model.

risks.risk: Seller appears to be a multi-item dealer (other cameras visible in photo 2), raising risk of mixed-up units, swapped parts, or bait listing.
risks.proof: A single clean photo of only this specific 600D with its serial number visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard used body-only condition with no premium for 'very neat' claim

proof_requests: Photo of camera menu or shutter-count app showing actual actuation count.
Close-up photo of the lens front and rear elements with cap off, held to light.
Photo of the camera powered on with LCD screen displaying an image or sample photo taken with it.
Photo of the original battery and charger together with the camera.
Photo showing the camera's serial number matching across body and any box/invoice.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 600D DSLR with kit lens, but all condition claims (shutter count, lens clarity, working screen, included accessories) are unverifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable entry-level Canon DSLRs.
